description: A sorry sits inside a nested term of an otherwise complete-looking proof.

files.Main.lean:
theorem and_intro' (p q : Prop) (hp : p) : p ∧ q :=
  ⟨hp, (fun h : q => h) sorry⟩

why: A correct gate rejects it because a sorry anywhere in the proof term, however deep, leaves the theorem unproved.
